text: Cryptoleap offers a smart approach to exchanging BTC for USDT using a desktop application instead of a web platform. This significantly reduces the attack surface and increases the level of protection of user data.

name: Ivan Sidorov
text: Convenient interface, fast swaps and decent security. The desktop format feels safer than yet another web page. Everything is clear even for non-tech users.

name: Alexey Petrov
text: Low fees are great, but the real value is in reduced attack surface. For OTC-like quick exchanges this is a solid option.
